Some of my 3D renders from 2025 ✨
A small collection of projects and personal work from 2025 — exploring product visualization, lighting, materials, composition, and 3D motion design across different styles and products.
From tech and audio products to lifestyle and beauty — each project was a chance to experiment, refine my workflow, and push the quality a little further. Still a lot more to show from 2025.
